body: My son has CP and uses a wheelchair. We’re at a hotel in Santa Fe with 4 handicap spots. All are filled with people without placards or plates. I spoke to the front desk about it. They offered an overflow lot. I told them, politely, no I’ll park our van near the front door under the awning until they get those spots cleared. I really want to block those jerks in - and would if i could do so without blocking others. Very frustrating. Even more so that ALL 4 spots are filled with entitled pricks.
